ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with approximately 5-8% high-intensity (white) pixels representing scars and markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Discrete white linear streaks and circular spots on a dark ground. Coordinates: clustered on mid-left lobe, a singular long curved mark on mid-right lobe, and dense clusters at both extreme lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped indentation with an approximate angle of 60 degrees and a depth ratio of ~0.15 relative to fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration with varying pixel-amplitude; higher frequency of peaks observed on the right lobe trailing edge compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Slightly concave trailing edge lobes curving toward a central vertex.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white clusters with irregular/circular morphology at both distal tips, consistent with localized surface disruption.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned high-contrast linear disruptions; distinct diagonal mark on center-right, multiple short horizontal marks on mid-left, and one near-vertical mark adjacent to the notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Widespread rake-like linear scarring across the central and lateral lobes; significant white callosity or scarring at the fluke tips.
